text:
ana: Starting change-window deploy for recommendations-service in eu-west. Release notes: https://go.redwood/release/rec-svc-2.1.0. Plan: 15% -> 60% -> 100% over 30m. Watch p95, error rate, and cpu heatmap.

deploy-bot: [deploy] recommendations-service v2.1.0 -> initiating canary at 15% (eu-west). id=deploy-1733333333. preflight checks ok.

ryan: hitting the SLO dash now. running a canary synthetic and trace sampler. tagging @oncall.

alert-bot: INFO: metric rule triggered: eu-west.rec.p95_delta > +10% (3m aggregated). current +13%.

ana: thanks, noted. Is that within warmup? we usually allow 5-7m for instantiation.

ryan: warmup passed 6m ago, this is post-warm. digging traces. QPS on canary is 45rps.

alert-bot: DEBUG: 5xx rate at 0.12% (below 0.5% threshold). KV cache miss rate up 2.3x on canary pods.

ryan: looks like kvcache TTL change in v2.1.0 causing higher miss rate. tail latency correlates to kvcache misses. see trace: `rec->kvcache miss -> compute spike -> p95 jump`.

ana: decision timeline: hold at 15% for one more 5m window. if p95 stays > +12% or 5xx > 0.5% we pin to v2.0.9 for eu-west. Pin command: `deploy-bot pin-version recommendations-service v2.0.9 --scope eu-west --reason "canary latency regression"`.

deploy-bot: canary hold engaged. monitoring hooks active.

pm-oliver: FYI sent to customers in EU list. Will update release notes if we pin.

ryan: manual experiment: increased local kvcache warmup by prefetching hot keys on canary -> p95 dropped to +5%.

ana: good signal. can we automate that prefetch in runtime config and re-run canary?

ryan: feasible via rollout flag `prefetch_hot_keys=true` in runtime config. safe to flip for canary nodes only.

ana: go ahead. apply as a canary-only runtime override. If we see p95 < +8% and 5xx < 0.2% for 10m, proceed to 60%.

deploy-bot: runtime-override applied: `prefetch_hot_keys=true` for canary subset. change id=cfg-1733333333.

alert-bot: INFO: p95 delta now +6% (after config change). 5xx steady 0.08%.

ana: moving to 60% in 5m unless regress. command: `deploy-bot shift-traffic recommendations-service 60% --eu-west`.

deploy-bot: shifting canary traffic to 60% now. ramp set to 30s.

alert-bot: WARNING: new rule fired: eu-west.backend.auth.502_spike -> small burst of 502s coincident with shift. aggregated 1.1% over 2m.

ryan: correlating traces show an upstream auth proxy returning 502 under burst. not related to rec's kv change. linking ops ticket to infra-auth.

ana: because 5xx > 0.5% we must pause. Rolling back traffic to 15% and opening rollback evaluation. command: `deploy-bot rollback-traffic recommendations-service 15% --reason "upstream 502 burst"`.

deploy-bot: traffic rollback to 15% initiated. canary paused. healthchecks show canary instances healthy.

pm-oliver: pulling back messaging until we know if we pin or re-run.

ana: triage steps: (1) coordinate with infra-auth to stabilize 502s (2) if upstream fixes within 10m and 5xx <0.3% we re-attempt shift, (3) if not, pin EU to v2.0.9 and re-open PR with TTL change.

ryan: opening a short-lived dashboard (link: https://dash.redwood/s/eu-west/rec/quick) and posting live traces.

alert-bot: NOTE: autoscaler scaled down canary pods during rollback window; keep an eye on small-n statistics.

ana: final decision pending infra-auth reply. if pin needed, I'll run `deploy-bot pin-version` by hand and add a release-note blurb. Everyone standby.

ryan: will post follow-up in 8m with infra-auth status.

pm-oliver: thanks all, appreciate the quick coordination. :pray:
